description: Defines the VariantSchema class and related nested classes for representing a shredding schema in Apache Spark, including scalar types, object fields, and schema properties.

classes.name: VariantSchema
classes.description: Represents a shredding schema with fields for typed value, variant, metadata, and nested schemas.

classes.name: ObjectField
classes.description: Represents a field within an object in the shredding schema, including its name and schema.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Abstract base class for scalar data types.

classes.name: IntegralType
classes.description: Represents an integral scalar type with specified size.

classes.name: DecimalType
classes.description: Represents a decimal scalar type with precision and scale.

classes.name: TimestampNTZType
classes.description: Represents a timestamp with no time zone.

methods.name: isUnshredded
methods.description: Checks if the variant schema is unshredded based on metadata and variant indices.
